title: Re-read YAML files between sequential edits
description: Two sequential Edit calls on a YAML workflow file without re-reading between them created duplicate blocks, corrupting structure. Rule: always re-read YAML files between edits; verify file state after hook-blocked edits.

title: Always assignee on issues, no sensitive data in evo logs

title: Include .gitattributes from the first commit
description: CRLF warnings accumulated across project lifecycle. Fixed in session 006 by normalizing 43 files. Rule: always include .gitattributes with '* text=auto eol=lf' from the first commit of any new repo.

title: Verify before acting — fact-check skill adopted
description: Created children symlinks in wrong path, rejected meddylib fact-check skill without evaluating substance. Adopted and adapted as /verify skill for path verification, convention checking, GitHub API queries, and pattern evaluation.

title: Incremental session bookkeeping and push after milestones
description: Session file showed stale status after Phase 2 completion. Repos had unpushed commits. Context exhaustion blocked recovery. Rule: update session file immediately after each phase; push repos after each milestone, not at session end.

title: Enforce test coverage tooling before adding rules
description: Added 100% coverage rule to CLAUDE.md but pytest-cov was not in dependencies. Command failed. Rule: ensure tooling works before adding rules. Coverage ratchet: never lower fail_under threshold.
